Class AdminUi

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.controllers.admin.AdminUi
final class AdminUi extends Object
Small presentation helpers shared by the admin screens. Keeping these in one place keeps status colours, date formats and spacing consistent across Task 3.
